name: NotchHub
title: The MacBook notch, put to work.
description: Meetings, clipboard, media, Focus, and system status in a local-first AppKit and SwiftUI dashboard.

name: Wallps
title: Give the desktop a little life.
description: Live video wallpapers, a local library, and battery-aware playback. SwiftUI / AVFoundation on Mac; Electron on Windows.

name: Internet Speed Reader
title: Know what your connection is doing.
description: Live traffic in the menu bar, manual speed tests, and outage detection. Public builds are ad-hoc signed, not notarized.

name: Muse Codex
title: A new model connection. The same tools.
description: A compatibility gateway that preserves Muse’s tools, approvals, and sandbox. Source-only, Apple silicon, pinned Muse version.

name: LifeOS Inbox
title: An inbox an agent can reason about.
description: Typed triage capabilities for follow-ups, obligations, and daily briefs, with services for persistence and scheduling.

name: The Keyboard Project
title: The Android typing feel, on iPhone.
description: AOSP-inspired key geometry and multi-item clipboard history inside an iOS keyboard extension.
